'''Vergesso Prime''', otherwise known as the '''Vergesso Asteroid''' or simply '''Vergesso''', was the largest of the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]], situated in the [[Vergesso III|third belt]] of the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
==Description==
The planetoid had a rather flat shape and consisted mostly of [[Lead/Legends|lead]] and [[Nickel]]-[[Iron/Legends|iron]], meaning that [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans could not penetrate to its interior. The Base installed several crater-like [[hangar/Legends|hangars]], some of which led inside to the capital ship docking cluster of [[the Facility]]. The surface also had a network of [[turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on its surface, intended to stop runners, attempting to leave without paying fees; and defend the Base against ambushes.<ref name="guide" />
==History==
The asteroid was first used by Dr. [[Ecile Vergesso]] who installed a [[Vergesso Base|survey base]] on the "western" hemisphere to study the system. After that project, the base was taken by a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="guide" />

It was patrolled by squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] because of high [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to plant an EMP device in a shipment at Vergesso heading for [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] to disable the Fleet there. The intention was to learn more about the [[Death Star/Legends|Imperial Superweapon]], but also set a chain reaction for the rescue of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. 

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Base was used by an exchange point for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] which grew to a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] of [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Transportation]]. That time, the base extended to the interior of the asteroid, impervious to casual scans. Each of the poles of the planetoid housed a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]. [[Tractor beam/Legends|Tractor beams]] kept a ring formation of companion asteroids around it, hiding the [[Asteroid Hangar]]s.<ref name="guide" />

A joint Ororo/Rebel Alliance installation, the base was [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|wiped out]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], and escorting Imperial starships.
